description: This file contains a series of shell commands for testing Git log graph output, including setup of test repositories, commits, branches, and various graph representations of merge scenarios with and without color customization.

methods.name: test_cmp_graph
methods.description: Function to compare the actual git log --graph output to expected output, with color disabled.

methods.name: test_cmp_colored_graph
methods.description: Function to compare the actual git log --graph output to expected output, with color enabled.
